name: Express
subtitle: Minimalist Node.js web framework
creator: TJ Holowaychuk
description: The classic Node.js web framework: routing plus a middleware chain, with few opinions about how you structure the rest. Express 5 arrived in 2024 as its first major release in a decade and requires Node 18 or newer.
useCases: The E in MERN and MEAN

concepts.explanation: app.get, app.post and friends map URLs to handlers.
Functions with (req, res, next) that run in order.
req holds input, res sends output.
Middleware with four arguments catches errors.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript

pairsWith.reason: Deploy with a database in one project

cons: No built-in structure, so large apps can get messy
You pick validation, auth and database layers yourself
Slower than newer frameworks like Fastify or Hono
